title: Generic monotone diagram and regular vertex generators
statement: Let $k$ have characteristic zero, let $M$ be a smooth finite-type $k$-scheme and $X\hookrightarrow M$ a closed subscheme [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-closed-immersion]. At $a\in X$ take the Taylor extension $K_a\subset L[[T_1,\ldots,T_n]]$, $L=\kappa(a)$, of its ideal in an etale coordinate chart [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Order exponents lexicographically by $(|\alpha|,\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$ and let $D$ be the exponents of first nonzero terms of elements of $K_a$. Coordinates can be chosen, after an etale localization and shrinking, so that $D$ is monotone: if $\alpha\in D$ and $i<j$, then $\alpha-\alpha_i e_i+\alpha_i e_j\in D$. Its finite vertices $\alpha_1<\cdots<\alpha_s$ can be lifted to regular generators $F_i$ of the ideal of $X$ on a neighbourhood of $a$, with initial Taylor exponent $\alpha_i$ and initial coefficient $1$. For any such lifts, if $d_i=|\alpha_i|$, their initial homogeneous forms have unique homogeneous division, for every prefix consisting of all vertices of degree at most a chosen bound: the quotient of $F_i$ is supported in $\Delta_i=\{\beta:\alpha_i+\beta\in(\alpha_i+\mathbf N^n)\setminus\bigcup_{j<i}(\alpha_j+\mathbf N^n)\}$ and the remainder outside the union of the prefix orthants. The Taylor ideal is generated with these supported quotients. For $K_a=0$ the vertex list is empty.
